hall.menu_item: Lobby hall: who is online, and chat
hall.title: Hall
hall.alone: You are the only one in the hall right now.
hall.no_messages: Nobody has said anything in the hall yet.
lobby.code_not_found: No match with that code. Check with whoever created the room.
lobby.needs_update: That room uses special roles, and your version of the game doesn't know them yet. Update the game to join.
lobby.roles_need_update: The match can't start with special roles: {names} needs to update the game. Or turn the roles off in the room rules.
role.assigned_phantom: You are the Phantom, an impostor. With your ability key you vanish for a few seconds: you don't show on the radar, your footsteps make no sound, and you are not heard in voice chat. Vanishing and coming back both make noise where you are, and killing brings you back at once.
role.vanish_active: You are already invisible. {seconds} seconds left.
role.assigned_shapeshifter: You are the Shapeshifter, an impostor. With your ability key you pick a living player and start appearing under their name on the radar, on the cameras, and to anyone checking who is in a room. Shifting makes noise, and while it lasts you cannot speak in voice chat. Whoever you kill learns who you really are. A meeting undoes it.
role.shift_active: You are already disguised. {seconds} seconds left.
role.assigned_detective: You are the Detective. You are a crewmate, and you can examine a body with your ability key, without reporting it: you learn how long ago the person died and which rooms the killer went through afterwards. Each body can only be examined once.
role.examine_result: Died {seconds} seconds ago. After that, the killer went through: {rooms}.
role.examine_result_no_trail: Died {seconds} seconds ago. The killer never left this room, or vanished through a vent.
role.examine_already_done: This body has already been examined.
role.assigned_guardian_angel: You are the Guardian Angel. While you are alive, you are an ordinary crewmate. After you die, get close to someone alive and use your ability key to protect them: for a while, no attack against them happens. Nobody finds out, not even the person you protected.
role.ability_only_dead: Your role only acts after you die.
role.assigned_noisemaker: You are the Noisemaker. You are an ordinary crewmate, but if you die, the whole ship hears that you died and in which room. Nobody knows it's you.
role.assigned_sheriff: You are the Sheriff. You play for the crew and you can kill, with the same key the impostor uses. But if you shoot someone who isn't an impostor, you're the one who dies. Be sure first.
role.sheriff_misfire: You shot an innocent. The shot turned on you.
role.assigned_engineer: You are the Engineer. You play for the crew, do your tasks, and can use the vents. Your ability key fixes the sabotage in progress from wherever you are, with a long recharge. Careful: whoever hears the vent lid doesn't know it's you.
role.assigned_crewmate: You are a Crewmate. Complete tasks and find the impostor.
role.assigned_impostor: You are the Impostor. Eliminate crewmates without being caught.
role.no_ability: Your role has no special ability.
role.ability_not_yours: That ability doesn't belong to your role.
role.ability_unavailable: You can't use the ability right now.

sabotage.wrong_panel: This is not the panel for this sabotage.
sabotage.panel_already_fixed: This panel is already fixed. The other one is still down.
sabotage.already_fixed_by_others: Someone fixed it before you. Panel closed.

task.submit_scan.name: Submit scan
task.submit_scan.instructions: Stand still on the scanner until it finishes. Anyone nearby hears the scan happening. ESC cancels.
task.water_plants.name: Water the seedlings
task.review_records.name: Review the recordings
task.fix_wiring.instructions: Use up and down arrows to hear the left-side wires, and left and right arrows for the right-side ones. Press Enter to connect the selected pair when the tone matches. ESC cancels.
task.download_data.instructions: Hold Space to download the data. Release to pause. ESC cancels.
task.empty_garbage.instructions: Hold Space until you hear the warning, then release and press Space again quickly when you hear the beep. ESC cancels.
task.align_engine.instructions: A beep plays continuously. Use left and right arrows to bring the sound to the center (both ears equal). Press Enter once it's centered to lock in. ESC cancels.
task.swipe_card.instructions: Press Enter at the right moment, between the two beeps, to swipe the card at the correct rhythm. ESC cancels.
task.unlock_manifolds.instructions: Listen to the tone sequence and repeat it with keys 1 to 4. Each key has its own tone, from lowest (1) to highest (4). ESC cancels.
task.fuel_engines.instructions: The panel first plays the tone of a full tank. Then hold Space: the filling sound rises, and you must release when it reaches that same tone. Releasing early means too little fuel; going past it overflows. ESC cancels.
task.fuel_engines.too_little: Too little fuel, the tank did not fill.
task.clear_asteroids.instructions: Each asteroid comes from one direction: left, ahead or right. The sound centred between both ears is the one coming from ahead. Shoot with the matching arrow before it passes. There are five. ESC cancels.
task.roll_dice.instructions: You need to roll {number}. Press Space to roll the dice, as many times as you need. ESC cancels.
task.water_plants.instructions: Three beds: one on the left, one ahead and one on the right. The watering can starts at the middle one. Use left and right arrows to carry it to the bed you are asked for and press Space to water. Watering at the wrong spot waters nothing. ESC cancels.
task.water_plants.next_bed_0: Water the bed on the left.
task.water_plants.next_bed_2: Now the bed on the right.
task.water_plants.wrong_spot: The watering can is not at that bed.
task.review_records.instructions: Listen to the corridor recording and count how many people walked past. Each person crosses from one side, with their own floor and rhythm. ESC cancels.
task.review_records.how_many: How many people walked past? Answer with keys 1 to 6.
